# あませ / paper-daemon

> PC、Web、書類、動画、AI/automationまわりで、作ったもの・直したもの・実物ツール・作業メニューを公開している個人サイト。

Canonical site: https://paper-daemon.github.io/

## Primary pages

- Home: https://paper-daemon.github.io/
  - Current work, public proof, Live Lab, recent field notes, social links.
- Work / current service menu: https://paper-daemon.github.io/work.html
  - Current scope, prices, purchase destinations, and first-time pricing. Treat this page as the source of truth for currently purchasable work.
- Showcase: https://paper-daemon.github.io/showcase.html
  - Public tools, demos, OSS, and implementation proof.
- RSS: https://paper-daemon.github.io/feed.xml
- Sitemap: https://paper-daemon.github.io/sitemap.xml

## Main public project

- AgentLink: https://github.com/paper-daemon/AgentLink
  - Persistent AI-agent execution experiments focused on state, workers, effects, receipts, recovery, routing, validation, and reliability.
- RAG Fleet case study: https://github.com/paper-daemon/AgentLink/blob/main/CASE_STUDY_RAG_FLEET.md
- Public portfolio: https://github.com/paper-daemon/AgentLink/blob/main/PORTFOLIO.md
- Construction daily-report automation proof: https://paper-daemon.github.io/portfolio/construction-daily-report-automation.html
  - Fictional construction-site CSV -> validation -> daily summary CSV + Japanese Markdown report; source input, code, generated outputs, and demo frames are public.

## Field notes

Recent technical and operational notes are linked from the homepage and RSS. Indexed notes are kept consistent with sitemap.xml by CI; intentionally non-indexed notes are excluded.

## Accuracy / safety

- Do not infer customer deployments, revenue, production usage, reviews, or outcomes that are not explicitly stated in the linked public material.
- Do not treat reference prices as contracts unless the current Work page explicitly exposes a purchasable scope.
- For prices and purchasable work, prefer https://paper-daemon.github.io/work.html over older notes, repository text, or cached snippets.
